'''Pyro flowers''' was a [[Plant/Legends|plant]] that had vibrant [[red]] petals. There were many gardens of these flowers in [[Barons Hed]] on [[Sulon/Legends|Sulon]] prior to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] occupation of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]].<ref name="Dark Forces: Rebel Agent">''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]''</ref>
